entries.title: Snow on the Road Home

summary.short: Bin gets dumped back into a snowdrift, fends off a frost wolf, finds a weird coin, and picks the gate or the back-alley route into Haven.
summary.default: Two months in a portal closet, one wolf, zero dignity. Bin reaches the Frostwood road, picks the gate or the Mug's back door, and goes looking for his sister Lily.

nextCandidates: 1.1.a Gate Office Day (front-door paperwork, captain's attitude)
1.1.b Back Door at the Frosted Mug (back-alley soup and a screaming log rumour)
syncSummary: Rumor: Bin was seen alive on the Frostwood road.
Hub mood: Frostbitten softens from anxious to mildly relieved.
Quest seed: Find Lily — Mitia's apothecary, eastern road.
Mystery seed: a rude-candle coin on the road. Not local.

entries.title: Gate Office Day

summary.short: Captain Lysa is glad Bin is alive and expresses it by handing him two months of unfiled supply manifests.
summary.default: Bin sorts the gate office floor, catches the frostcap shortage hidden in the dates, learns Lily is at the apothecary, and pockets a third matching foreign coin.

nextCandidates: 1.2.a Apothecary's Apprentice (Lily and a herb run)
syncSummary: Quest started: Find Lily.
Hub problem: weird foreign coins in the gate's lost-and-found tin.
Hint: frostcap shipments are being 'redirected' on Wednesdays and over-delivered on Tuesdays in a different handwriting.

entries.title: Back Door at the Frosted Mug

summary.short: Bin sneaks in the Mug's back door, eats soup, brawls a drunk patron over a chair, and the host begs him to look at the screaming log in the woodshed.
summary.default: Town gossip has a leading 'sea monster' theory. The Mug owes Bin a favour. There is a log behind the woodshed that screams when the wind hits it sideways. Tomorrow's job is the log.

nextCandidates: 1.2.b The Haunted Firewood (a screaming log behind the Mug)
syncSummary: Hub problem: the Mug's woodshed has a screaming log.
Item: a third rude-candle coin appears on the Mug's cellar floor.
Hint: Lily is at Mitia's apothecary on the eastern road.

entries.title: Apothecary's Apprentice

summary.short: Bin reaches Mitia's apothecary and discovers Lily has been quietly running half of it. They walk the frostcap grove together.
summary.default: Lily is taller and sharper. Mitia hands Bin a coat. The frostcap grove is missing exactly the shipments the gate logged as 'redirected.' Bin and Lily find out why.

nextCandidates: 1.3 The Cat Job (a missing tavern cat, both routes converge)
syncSummary: Quest progress: Find Lily — found, slightly horrified at his beard.
Quest started: Frostcap Shortage.
Mystery progress: A fourth rude-candle coin sits on the apothecary windowsill.

entries.title: The Haunted Firewood

summary.short: The Mug's screaming log turns out to contain a grumpy frost sprite. Bin coaxes it out, fights three frost rats, and walks the sprite to the apothecary.
summary.default: The log is a sprite. The sprite is rude. Bin delivers it in a labelled jar and meets his sister halfway through the comedy.

nextCandidates: 1.3 The Cat Job (a missing tavern cat, both routes converge)
syncSummary: Hub problem cleared: the Mug's screaming log.
Item: one frost sprite in a labelled jar.
Mystery progress: A fourth rude-candle coin sits on the apothecary windowsill.

entries.title: The Cat Job

summary.short: A six-year-old hires Bin and Lily to find Mittens the tavern cat. The cat is at a hermit's hut. The hermit has a tin of rude-candle coins.
summary.default: Three townsfolk, three sightings, one accurate. Mittens is at Hermit Rolf's. Wolves on the way home. The coin pattern matches a pattern of questions about who is sick in Frostbitten.

nextCandidates: 1.4 Bread, Stew, and a Knock at the Door (family dinner, sealed envelope)
syncSummary: Quest cleared: Find Mittens.
Hub mood: Frostbitten reaches reluctantly cheerful.
Mystery progress: The buyer is a woman in good boots, paying for cough-related questions.
Ten rude-candle coins now catalogued.

entries.title: Bread, Stew, and a Knock at the Door

summary.short: Family dinner at Garr's. Stew is on the second boil. A stranger arrives at the door before dessert. The chapter is quiet and closes Arc 1.
summary.default: Bin sits at the kitchen table for the first time in two months. There is yelling. There is bread. Garr's journal lists travellers, coins, and a repeated cough-syrup question. A sealed envelope changes hands at the door. Nobody dies.

nextCandidates: Arc 1 closes — side quests, daily errands, and slow-build leads continue from the Quest tab.
Arc 2 begins later: the buyer is named, the coins are explained, the chimera (eventually) wakes up around chapter 5.
syncSummary: Quest cleared: Family Dinner.
Hub mood: Frostbitten reaches settled.
Lore unlocked: Garr's journal of three travellers, six coins, and one repeating cough-syrup question.
Mystery: the buyer is a woman in good boots. Name still unknown.
Arc 1 closes. Side content and Arc 2 build follow.
